title: CORE-6962 · Package ⓘ & bank-partner popups: desktop click + tablet tap + modal styling
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6962](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6962/rf-package-and-bank-partner-popups-desktop-click-doesnt-open-styled) · state `In Progress` · priority P2

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Page:** `/`
**Live:** [https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/](<https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/>)  ·  **Test:** [https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/](<https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app/>)
**Component/area:** Package info icons (ⓘ) in "Find the perfect company formation package"; "Our business banking partners" cards
**Breakpoints:** 1800 / 1024 (desktop) · 768 (tablet) · 360 (mobile)

**Issue** — The clone rebuilt these popups differently from Live. Live shows a **hover tooltip on desktop** and a **tap-to-open modal on touch**. On the clone: a **desktop click doesn't open** either popup, the **package ⓘ also fails to open on tablet (768)**, and where a modal does open the **styling differs** from Live.

### What's wrong  (Expected = Live / Actual = Clone)

| Trigger | Breakpoint | Live | Clone |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Package ⓘ | 1800 / 1024 (desktop) | hover shows tooltip, stays | hover shows popup, but a **click closes it** → click never opens |
| Package ⓘ | 768 (tablet) | **tap opens a modal** | **tap does nothing** — renders a hover-only variant at ≥768 (no `aria-haspopup`) |
| Package ⓘ | 360 (mobile) | tap opens modal | tap opens modal ✓ (works) |
| Bank-partner card | 1800 / 1024 (desktop) | hover shows tooltip (hover-driven) | hover works; **desktop click opens nothing** |
| Bank-partner card | 768 / 360 (touch) | tap opens modal | tap opens modal ✓ (works) |

**Modal styling (where a modal opens):** Live's modal has a **red ✕** (#e74c3c) and a light grey border; the clone's modal has a **grey ✕** and no border (subtle shadow only). Content and backdrop otherwise match.

**Desktop-click — needs reviewer confirmation:** an automated test found that on **Live**, both the package ⓘ and the bank-partner card are **hover tooltips** that do **not** stay open after a click + mouse-away. If Live does persist on click (as observed by the reviewer), the clone's desktop click failure is a real gap; if Live is hover-only, desktop behaviour matches and the confirmed defects are the **tablet (768) package ⓘ dead-on-tap** and the **modal styling**. Please confirm the Live desktop click behaviour.

**Steps to navigate**

* **Desktop (1800 / 1024):** hover a package ⓘ / bank-partner card → popup shows. Now **click** it → **Live:** opens / stays. **Clone:** nothing opens.
* **Tablet (768):** tap a package ⓘ → **Live:** modal opens. **Clone:** nothing. (Bank-partner cards open a modal on both — fine at 768.)
* **Mobile (360):** tap → both open a modal; compare the ✕ colour and border.

### Evidence

**Desktop @1800 — after click**

|  | Live | Clone |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Package ⓘ |  |  |
| Bank-partner card |  |  |

**Tablet @768 — package ⓘ after tap**

| Live (modal opens) | Clone (nothing opens) |
| -- | -- |
|  |  |

### Definition of Done

- [ ] Package ⓘ and bank-partner popups open on the same interaction as Live at every breakpoint (desktop **click** works; package ⓘ opens on **tablet** tap).
- [ ] Where a modal opens, its styling matches Live (red ✕, light grey border).
- [ ] Mobile (360) already opens on both — keep working, just align styling.
- [ ] Hover / focus / active states checked.
- [ ] No visual regressions introduced.

---
### Planning note
The ticket leaves ONE question open ("Please confirm the Live desktop click behaviour"). It is not a judgment call — it is an observation, so AC1 makes measuring it on live in a headed browser part of the task and AC2 makes the fix conditional on the answer. The tablet-tap and modal-styling defects are confirmed and unconditional.

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: Live's desktop (1800/1024) click behaviour for the package ⓘ and bank-partner card is confirmed in a HEADED browser and recorded in the PR body — the ticket flags automated results (hover-only) as contradicting the reviewer.

Clone matches whatever live does on desktop click: if live persists on click, clone opens/persists; if live is hover-only, clone's current hover-only behaviour is documented as already-matching (no change).
Package ⓘ opens on TABLET (768) tap — currently dead (clone renders a hover-only variant at ≥768 with no `aria-haspopup`). Live opens a modal.
Where a modal opens, styling matches live: red ✕ (#e74c3c) and light grey border (clone currently grey ✕, no border).
Mobile (360) keeps working for both triggers; hover/focus/active states checked; no visual regressions.
